messages:
sam: Found an old partner token inside gs://partner-archive/2026/03/21/debug-archive.gz while debugging a customer issue. looks like token prefix `st_` and maybe long-lived.
maya: can you paste a sanitized line and object path?
sam: snippet: `Authorization: Stashlink st_XXXX_REDACTED_YYYY`
leo: if it's archived logs we need containment + rotation. partner should revoke immediately.
ops_oncall: i'll schedule a scrub. dry-run: `gsutil cp gs://partner-archive/... - | zgrep -n "st_"` then replace object with redacted stub. coordinating with partner now.
maya: also search Vault paths secret/data/partners/* and audit for any service identities that created/used partner creds around that time.
security_bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-3001 (partner token in archived blob). Owner: eng-security.
leo: found two hits from svc-sync-legacy at 03:12 UTC in storage audit logs. that lambda reads a wrapped blob; we should rotate the KMS key and rewrap the secret.
ops_oncall: scrub executed, partner confirmed revocation. initiating KMS rewrap plan and RBAC tighten on the archive bucket. timeline: KMS rewrap in 4h, lambda update to Vault in 8h.
maya: i'll open RBAC PR to deny the legacy lambda and restrict read to ingestion service principal. also drafting Vault policy to forbid long-lived static partner tokens (TTL <=1h).
sam: i'll follow up with a short postmortem and checklist updates for partner onboarding (require short-lived OAuth or Vault integration).
